theme: Proving who you are: authorization headers, bearer tokens and OAuth

terms.definition: A request header that carries the credentials that prove who you are.
terms.example: Add the authorization header to every request.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com")!
var r = URLRequest(url: u)
let k = "Authorization"
r.setValue("abc", forHTTPHeaderField: k)
print(r.value(forHTTPHeaderField: k)!)

terms.definition: A secret string that a request sends to prove the user is logged in.
terms.example: Never print the bearer token in the logs.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let token = "abc123"
let value = "Bearer " + token
print(value)

terms.definition: A standard that lets users sign in with another service without sharing their password.
terms.example: We use OAuth for the Google sign-in.
terms.code:
import Foundation
var c = URLComponents(string: "https://a.x.com")!
let q = URLQueryItem(name: "id", value: "app1")
c.queryItems = [q]
print(c.url!)

Learn to explain signing in and sending credentials: Authorization Header, Bearer Token & OAuth, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Authorization Header - A request header that carries the credentials that prove who you are.
Bearer Token - A secret string that a request sends to prove the user is logged in.
OAuth - A standard that lets users sign in with another service without sharing their password.

Authorization Header - A request header that carries the credentials that prove who you are.
한국어: Authorization Header: 내가 누구인지 증명하는 자격 증명을 담는 요청 헤더

한국어: OAuth: 비밀번호를 공유하지 않고 다른 서비스로 로그인하게 해 주는 표준

landscape.hook: Can you explain Authorization Header, Bearer Token and OAuth in English?

dialogue.title: Error 401

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the profile request returns 401. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The server does not know who you are. Add an authorization header.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What goes into the authorization header?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your credentials. Our code sets it with `setValue`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And what is a bearer token?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A secret string. The request sends the bearer token to prove the user is logged in.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why does the word Bearer come first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It tells the server the kind of token. Whoever bears it gets access.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where does the token come from?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: From OAuth. OAuth lets users sign in with another service without sharing their password.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. OAuth gives your app a bearer token after the sign-in.

dialogue.code:
import Foundation
let token = "abc123"
let k = "Authorization"
let bearer = "Bearer " + token
var r = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "x.com")!)
r.setValue(bearer, forHTTPHeaderField: k)
